name: Question 60
problem: Use the method of Lagrange multipliers to find the minimum value of the function $f(x,y,z)=x-2y-2z$ on the intersection of the plane $x+y+z=2$ and the cylinder ${x}^{2}+{z}^{2}=1.$
worked_solution:
We need to find the minimum value of 

$$
f(x,y,z)=x-2y-2z
$$

subject to the constraints 

$$
g(x,y,z)=x+y+z=2,\,h(x,y,z)={x}^{2}+{z}^{2}=1.
$$

Since $f(x,y,z)$ is continuous and the constraint is closed and bounded, $f(x,y,z)$ reaches a global maximum and a global minimum on the constraint. 

Therefore, by the method of Lagrange multipliers, we must solve the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}∇f(x,y,z)=\lambda ∇g(x,y,z)+\mu ∇h(x,y,z) \\ g(x,y,z)=2 \\ h(x,y,z)=1\end{aligned}
$$

We start by expanding the first equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}∇f(x,y,z) & =\lambda ∇g(x,y,z)+\mu ∇h(x,y,z) \\ ⟨{f}_{x},{f}_{y},{f}_{z}⟩ & =\lambda ⟨{g}_{x},{g}_{y},{g}_{z}⟩+\mu ⟨{h}_{x},{h}_{y},{h}_{z}⟩ \\ ⟨1,-2,-2⟩ & =\lambda ⟨1,1,1⟩+\mu ⟨2x,0,2z⟩\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, we have the following system:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}1=\lambda +2\mu x \\ -2=\lambda  \\ -2=\lambda +2\mu z\end{aligned}\,⇒\,{\begin{aligned}x=\frac{3}{2\mu } \\ \lambda =-2 \\ \mu z=0\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Notice that $\mu $ can't be zero since this leads to a contradiction. So, from the third equation above, we must have $z=0.$

Next, we substitute $z=0$  into the second constraint:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+{z}^{2} & =1 \\ {x}^{2} & =1 \\ x & =\pm 1\end{aligned}
$$

 

Finally, we substitute $x$ and $z$ into the first constraint:

- If $x=1$ and $z=0,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x+y+z & =2 \\ 1+y+0 & =2 \\ 1+y & =2 \\ y & =1.\end{aligned}
$$

- If $x=-1$ and $z=0,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}x+y+z & =2 \\ -1+y+0 & =2 \\ -1+y & =2 \\ y & =3.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f$ has possible extreme values at the points

$$
(1,1,0),\,(-1,3,0).
$$

We evaluate $f$ at each of these points. These are given in the following table:

| $(x,y,z)$ | $(1,1,0)$ | $(-1,3,0)$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x,y,z)$ | $-1$ | $-7$ |

Therefore, the function reaches a minimum value at $(-1,3,0),$ and its  minimum value is $-7.$
